q: The HWI inequality in optimal transport connects entropy H, Wasserstein distance W, and Fisher information I via:
opts: H(ν|γ) ≤ W₂(μ,ν) · √I(μ|γ) − W₂(μ,ν)²/2 (where γ is a reference measure)
exp: The HWI inequality interpolates between the log-Sobolev inequality and the Talagrand inequality. It states H(ν|γ) ≤ W₂(ν,γ)√I(ν|γ) − W₂²/2 under appropriate curvature conditions (positive Ricci curvature).
